title: BunchingAlert
description: One bunched pair in one event-time window. Written by consumers/bunching/job.py, sunk into raw.bunching_alerts by connect/bunching_alerts.json. See consumers/bunching/detect.py for what each field means.

gap_ft.description: Distance between the pair along the shape, in feed units. FEET for 423 of 424 shapes; see the unit note in consumers/bunching/config.py.

window_end.description: Epoch SECONDS, as an INTEGER and not a float. Two reasons, both measured: the connector's TimestampConverter refuses FLOAT64 (Schema Schema{FLOAT64} does not correspond to a known timestamp type format), and unix.precision=seconds is required or every row lands in 1970.

deviation_a.description: Seconds late, as Metro claimed it. NULL means it could not be computed, which is not the same as 0 (ADR 0005).
